response.justification: The candidate lacks direct C++ experience in industrial automation or high-performance systems, with most roles centered on web technologies (TypeScript, Node.js, DLang) and no demonstrable use of STL, multi-threading, message brokers, IEC 62443, or industrial protocols critical to the role.
strengths: Strong full-stack experience with modern web and dev-ops tools
Proven ability to lead open-source projects and technical workshops
Extensive background in distributed systems and event-driven architectures
concerns: Minimal to no recent C++ or STL work despite 12+ years of experience
No evidence of industrial cybersecurity standards (IEC 62443) or IoT protocols
Lacks exposure to on-premises industrial platforms or real-time embedded systems
